messages:
Olivia: Quick status check on the runtime sprint tie-ups — specifically kernel optimizations, continuous-batching A/B, and KV prefetch rollout. Who's owning each and what are the blockers? Need a short plan by EOW.

Raj: I'll own the kernel-optim PRs (refs: #432, #435). Main blocker is flaky perf CI on p4d. Local repro is OK but CI shows memory spikes. I'm investigating.

Henry: KV prefetch rollout is on me. Plan is a canary in Dedicated pool (2 nodes) and telemetry gated. Blocker: need infra to reserve nodes & a final config with reserve slots.

Maria: Continuous-batching A/B is my area. I can run the eval harness + prompt sets once rollout hooks exist. Prefer to start after KV canary is stable to avoid cross-noise.

Steve: @Maria I can add the rollout hooks (canary, metric thresholds, auto-fallback). Send me the eval prompt set and the metrics to watch.

Maria: Posted evals link in docs channel; primary metrics: p50/p95 tokens/ms, error-rate, logits divergence. Also will share the prompt set in the PR description.

ci-bot: Build #432 failed on kernel-test: OOM during attention kernel step. Log excerpt:
```
2026-06-02T14:23:01Z kernel_test: allocate 12.1G > limit 11.8G -> OOM
stack: runtime::alloc -> attention::compute -> kernel::launch
```

Raj: I see the same logs locally when running sequence=2048. Hypothesis: kernel config not selecting quantized path. Quick patch: force kernel-quant variant to see mem delta.

Olivia: Decision for now: Raj to try kernel-quant branch and report CI perf diff by Wed noon. Henry to confirm infra reservation by Wed EOD. Maria/Steve to hold batching A/B until infra green. If any of those slip, annotate the sprint board and escalate. :thumbsup:

Tasha: I added owners and dependency tags to the sprint doc (link in #eng-runtime-docs). Also pinged #eng-infra for the node reservation and tagged @infra-oncall.

Henry: Infra just replied — reserved 2 nodes for KV canary: kv-canary-02/03. Credentials and kube config shared in secure channel.

Raj: kernel-quant branch reduces memory ~10% in local perf runs at seq=2048. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/440 

Olivia: Great progress. If CI still flakes, we may have to fall back to sequence-based routing or lower batch-size cap. Keep updates short here; I'll compile for the EOW sync.

Steve: I'll wire the rollout hooks tonight and post the hook config here.

Raj: PR opened and CI triggered. cc @Olivia @Henry

Olivia: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in the EOW thread. If someone needs extra hands, DM me.
